proposal.expected_effect: Underspecified experiments retain their history while recording what contract fields are missing and whether current grounded evidence can supply them; blocked work does not masquerade as executable experimentation.
proposal.falsification: Reject if the candidate invents observables or evidence references, hides unresolved backlog, promotes blocked work to evidence-ready, or regresses preserved behavior.
proposal.hypothesis: Explicitly tracing each missing observable, evidence source, and resolution rule can distinguish internally resolvable experiment specifications from work blocked on unavailable evidence without inventing facts.
proposal.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
proposal.selection_rationale: Protected system diagnostic SD000004 reported specification_backlog; this direct diagnostic signal takes priority over aggregate metric saturation.
proposal.test_plan: Construct experiments with and without grounded resolvable evidence, verify missing contract fields and resolution paths are explicit, verify no evidence reference or executable contract is fabricated, and run the baseline-owned preservation gate.
proposal.title: Triage experiment specification backlog
